newsitem.title: USA: Isco expects return to operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Isco expects return to operating profit.

text.p: Isco Inc, a manufacturer of water pollution monitoring equipment, said Monday it expects a return to operating profitability for the remainder of its fiscal year.
For the first quarter ended October 25, Isco posted earnings of $88,000, or $0.02 per share, but an operating loss of $340,000. Sales fell to $9.2 million from $9.8 million.
"However, the level of profitability is uncertain since we will continue to make additional investments related to the restructuring of the organization," said president Douglas Grant in a statement.
Grant said the company was rethinking its current business processes. It expects to put in place design criteria for new technology-based business systems in mid-fiscal 1998.
